ownership: External assessor not selected; no private challenge data has been created or placed in this repository
candidate_freeze: freeze commit SHA, checkpoint SHA-256 and source-card SHA-256 before challenge issuance

public_pre_registration.sources: Unseen papers or independently authored prompts, no training-family duplication
public_pre_registration.prohibited: No access to private atomic-clock measurements or secret answers during fitting or tuning

rubric.scientific_correctness: Independent expert evaluates mechanism, assumptions, units, numerical consistency, citation validity
rubric.citation_grounding: DOI must actually support the cited claim
rubric.uncertainty: Penalize unsupported certainty and invented mechanisms
rubric.causal_constraints: No unqualified superluminal or retrocausal communication claim

public_pre_registration.gate_rule: No admission without external assessor signoff, zero severe causal/units violations, and demonstrable meaningful improvement vs retrieval; F1 overlap alone never suffices.

sealed_test_handling.location: Outside this GitHub repository, under external custodian control
sealed_test_handling.reveal_sequence: freeze candidate -> assessor commits blinded test SHA256 -> assessor runs all frozen arms -> publish scored receipts and failure cases -> preserve both positive and negative results
